rows.text: # Task cycle adversarial self-review4

2026-09-09. Agent self-review, not an external planning verdict. No runtime or
numeric allocation acceptance is recorded here.
## Authority and causal separation

The current proposed split is consistent in direction with Architecture10–12 and
North Star17: adopted prospective state, bounded active context, forecast-relative
appraisal, transient affect and later motive formation remain distinguishable.
The exact new source/type/profile matrix still must close before implementation.
Campaign2 remains OPEN; a growing collection of draft records is not traversability.

The lifecycle itself is independent of later motive calibration. Finish and review
its own contract without making a future option formula a lifecycle prerequisite.
Keep the successor activation gate separate from semantic shape acceptance.
## Correct the target capability description

The registration closure's phrase "selected key/prior associations" must not mean
reading priors during target resolution. The target requirement first resolves only
the finite keys and exact paths from admitted subject, time and immutable specs.
Collision preflight completes for the entire140 stage. Only then does execution
obtain a capability bound to those exact paths and read each prior from B0.

There is no public method accepting an arbitrary key, task referent, state root or
selector. No prior value is cached into a target descriptor before collision checks.
This is a new finite multi-target requirement; it does not silently broaden343's
single subject projection or the predictor's own single-key contract.
## Make validation delegation explicit too

The proposed task170 field13, ValidationInvariants, should contain the same one-element
spec-reference list as fields3/7/8/10/11/16. This explicitly delegates the finite
holder/criterion/window invariant to its sole spec. The previous empty-field13
proposal is withdrawn before acceptance. Fields4/5/6/9/14/15 remain empty under the
fixed specialization. Do not use source/change metadata as executable psychology.
## Workspace output and parent admission are not interchangeable

Workspace Known copies the exact361 prior and support once. The empty/Unavailable
branch consumes its fixed output occurrence but cannot claim a sensory evidence
identity. Downstream nested payloads must equal the actual emitted parent output.
Merely validating a well-formed nested workspace or looking up its ID in trace is
insufficient. This gives appraisal its operands without a generic belief resolver.

The private child association is derived after scheduler allocation. It binds the
complete event, exact parent and output, not just EventId. Restore must reconstruct
that association from the original prefix, including a pending50 child if the save
contract ever admits such a boundary. Current saves remain quiescent, so no new
mid-instant persistence permission is implied.
## Concern is not an already compiled Reason modifier

TaskConcern intensity remains an event-local affect value. The future source adapter
must give it an explicit SourceRole, sign, reason attribution and evidence basis.
Do not directly add it to the base commitment pressure or feed it to a dice modifier
slot without that contract. In particular the historical compiler uses bounded
role consolidation before relevance/quantization, not raw signal addition.

The concern draft's0..1 range does not establish a calibrated dice unit. It is not
licensed to call current affect RecentExperience merely because the historical
compiler has that modifier slot. Either explicitly specialize that mapping with
correct semantics or add the governed current-context receiving family; preserve
the historical two-role consolidation mechanism as a control.
## A narrower identity-feedback witness is actually available

The intact-cycle sketch required identity to "match a future reason differently."
That is sufficient but unnecessarily strong. The actual retained activation rule
allows equal standing contributions to have different activation effects when
the prior situational contributions differ. This avoids inventing a per-task trait
bonus or falsifying identity semantics just to break a symmetric scene.

The read-only historical experiment is recorded in
CAMPAIGN2_TASK_IDENTITY_ACTIVATION_EXPLORATION.json and reproduced by
scripts/explore-task-identity-activation.mjs. It supplies explicit component inputs:
raw base1/10 for both, situation3/10 versus0, threshold3/10. The initial attempt
using raw standing1/4 failed to activate the second nucleus, because the actual
consolidator bounds the base to1/11 and standing to1/5. This failed design assumption
is retained in the report. With raw standing1/3, bounded standing1/4 gives:

before: A active, B inactive
    after:  A active, B active
    base:   1/11 for both, unchanged
    no base after retirement: neither nucleus exists

The symmetric-situation control remains symmetric. No assertion that equal modifiers
change an already symmetric contest is made. No RNG, full arbitration, identity
learning, authorship qualification or generated motive/option path was executed.
The numbers show a viable design possibility, not selected model calibration.
## Required historical decisions preserved

MEC-020/EXP-013 will port live obligation pressure and execute retirement rather than
simulate a changed list. RET-010/011 remain rejected controls. MEC-012..018 and
MEC-022 retain correlation consolidation, base/standing/situation separation,
activation floors, exact dice, immutable expression and qualified identity feedback.
The exploratory control imports reference only in a research script; active src
does not import reference and no historical file changed.

MEC-005/007 are not retired by the new fixed workspace policy. The first bounded
task policy has no semantic-salience claim; the historical multiplicative salience
control remains required where the later scaffold exercises that mechanism.
## Next autonomous work

Consolidate these corrections into the task candidate and exact registration/member
inventory; finish the separate procedural-plan/motive bridge and its source basis;
then complete symbolic shape reviews and allocation gates before canonical code.
The user's continuing authorization covers this specification work. No user or
planning-agent decision is currently needed.
EXECUTED HISTORICAL COMPONENT EXPLORATION; NOT CAMPAIGN2 QUALIFICATION

The first attempted1/4 raw standing witness did not activate B. Actual historical role consolidation applies boundedResponse before relevance;1/11+1/5 is below3/10. Corrected1/3 raw standing gives1/11+1/4 above3/10.
Equal standing contributions can activate only the previously inactive nucleus when situation differs. Consolidated base motives remain unchanged; modifiers cannot resurrect a missing base.
Signals are explicit research component inputs, not generated Campaign2 psychological intermediates.
No identity evidence accumulation, qualification, efficacy, option generation, RNG or full arbitration is exercised.
Parameters exhibit a mathematical possibility; they are not selected production calibration.
RecentExperience is the historical compiler slot; a new concern source requires its own semantic modifier/provenance contract.
No claim that equal shifts change an already-symmetric contest.
# Task lifecycle — bounded qualification

2026-09-09. **Internal agent adversarial review: task-commitment/0.2-candidate
QUALIFIED in the frozen lifecycle profile.** This is not an external planning-agent
verdict. Campaign 2 and its intact cognitive cycle remain OPEN.

The governing model is campaign2-task-commitment-model/FREEZE.json:
74aa96b751fb92dfaf693e6249ecc0abfe35df3493dd13919ddb254e4ee3d45e.
No frozen model, allocation, schema, numeric or symbolic contract changed during
implementation. The two runtime review corrections enforce existing obligations:
complete resolution before collision sealing, and same-instant observation carriage.
## Control crosswalk

| Vector | Executed bounded evidence | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| TC-A | Actual two-kind CONTENT and key roles reject holder-as-task and task-as-character; distinct same-holder instances survive | PASS |

| TC-K | Fresh recurrence instance becomes eligible while the previous instance remains terminal; later evidence cannot rewrite its support | PASS |
| TC-L | Actual historical live-list component comparison, real historical lifecycle suite, immortal/terminal substitutions, scalar-status exclusion and stakeholder-key rejection | PASS, lifecycle comparison scope |

TC-L does not claim a canonical Campaign2 motive producer or identity-rich decision
cycle. The comparison script externally selects a live list from public lifecycle
state and invokes the actual historical component. It is research instrumentation,
not a workspace or pressure-generation adapter. The preserved four historical
lifecycle tests cover the historical identity-rich pressure boundary. Porting and
qualifying that boundary on the new generated psychological path remains mandatory.
No historical mechanism is retired by this bounded qualification.
## Evidence and preservation

TASK_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_PROOF_REV2.json records24 baseline runtime/boundary tests and
seven detected current-source substitutions: immortal clock, strict lower endpoint,
terminal overwrite, delayed observation, omitted collision, omitted preflight seal,
and unbound source. Revision1 preserves the same experiment's earlier runner receipt;
its shell exit inherited the intentional mutant failures. Revision2 completes with

The separately executed preservation file has9 passing tests. It includes actual
A plus two D clocks, later forecast exclusion, unchanged terminal provenance and
the17-event instant with consecutive probes and two deadlines. The64 runtime control

The active regression baseline passed109 files/974 tests before the final task-only

TASK_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_AUDIT_REV2.json verifies212 preserved fingerprints and both

The shared-runtime changes also triggered fresh inherited proof receipts:

STAGE_BOUNDARY_PROOF_REV5, ADAPT_ROLLBACK_PROOF_REV3 and FCT_C_PROOF_REV4.

## Deliberately unfinished

Task plan, workspace, appraisal, concern, motives, options, reasons, retained dice,
identity qualification, intent, attempts and world consequences are not supplied by
this lifecycle. Drafts remain drafts until their own shape/allocation/profile gates.
Neither a task status nor its trace may fill those causal boxes. ORD-001 remains open;
no same-event phase30 belief read/write is introduced. PERSIST-I remains deferred;
this profile consumes no RNG. The next work is exact cognitive operand and plan/source

# Task lifecycle — adversarial self-review2

2026-09-09. Agent review. **Whole shape withheld.** Three corrections below govern
the next draft; no allocation or implementation is authorized.
## Authored availability must not mean adopted commitment

The first draft required every declared task to be Open in S0. That incorrectly
coupled model content availability to a character's adoption, and forced the no-task
control to change the model. CONTENT explicitly permits goal/commitment facts but
does not make every available item a current psychological state.

Correct the initial-state domain: any subset of the finite declared task keys may
be present, and each present initial value must be Open. Absence means **not adopted**,
not a zero-strength commitment and not implicit Open. Terminal initial values remain
forbidden in this first profile; terminal history must be generated. Runtime
settlement never inserts or removes a task key.

Measurement applicability still selects the same finite holder/criterion/time keys
without reading status. A selected absent prior produces no change. It must not be
silently adopted. A terminal prior also produces no change. This keeps source
dispatch independent from state while making actual prior absence observable in
the trace and workspace projection.
## Private schedule must stay coupled across adoption interventions

Derive one deadline association for **every declared concrete task key**, not only
the adopted subset. The private deadline handler reads that exact prior. Absent or
already-terminal prior yields no change; Open yields DeadlineMissed.

This makes same-model no-task/live-task initial-state comparisons preserve future
event and allocator slots. A model definition does not leak into another character's
knowledge: these are trusted host target associations, produce no cognitive output,
and authorize no workspace content or motive when the actual task prior is absent.

At quiescence T≥Deadline, every **present** task is terminal. An absent task is legal.
The old proposal's "missing required initial task state is an error" is withdrawn;
unknown or foreign keys remain errors. Prefix restore authenticates both initial
adoption and the constant declared deadline schedule.
## Content fields should state their delegation explicitly

The proposed empty UnitsDomainsBounds/DeclaredInputs/EpistemicVisibility fields left
their relationship to the referenced spec too implicit. Use the exact one-element
spec-reference list in these170 fields:

DeclaredInputs
    UnitsDomainsBounds
    EpistemicVisibility
    Lifecycle
    FormalSeamMappings
    ReferencedRegistryIds

The fixed specialization defines their respective meanings: holder/criterion input
domain; exact criterion/window domain; adopted-holder-only cognitive access; the
finite lifecycle; the named receiving seam; and generic registry reference closure.
ReferencedContentIds remains exactly HolderContentId. The one spec remains the sole
source of values; repeated references do not create competing criteria/deadlines.

DeclaredOutputs and WorldEffects are empty because content emits nothing and causes
no world effect. Preconditions/ObservationAffordances and the remaining descriptive
fields are empty in this version, with actual receiving preconditions fixed by the
specialization. No executable text or callback may fill those fields.

This explicit delegation is a new task-kind specialization, not a reinterpretation
of character-kind content. It must be tested for missing/extra/different spec refs,
cross-holder task records, duplicate concrete IDs, unresolved refs and unchanged
Character qualification before that specialization passes.
## Preserved decisions and next closure work

Keep concrete1038/authored-origin identities, half-open windows, distinct perceived
satisfaction/deadline status, no semantic lifecycle outputs, no runtime occurrence
allocation for lifecycle evaluation, and the independent original deliberation cue.
Keep the new prospective topology explicit; do not hide goals in learned belief.

Remaining implementation blockers are exact registration/role inventory, exhaustive
combined140 admission and failure ordering, and workspace/appraisal/motive shapes.
These are specification work under the current autonomous authorization. No user
decision is needed to correct the proposal, and no runtime files change here.
# Task lifecycle runtime — internal adversarial review

2026-09-09. Agent self-review under the user's independent-work authorization.
This is implementation evidence in progress, not an external verdict or TC-A..L
qualification. Campaign 2 remains OPEN.
## Accepted construction and current implementation

The frozen model is campaign2-task-commitment-model/FREEZE.json, digest
74aa96b751fb92dfaf693e6249ecc0abfe35df3493dd13919ddb254e4ee3d45e.
It realizes task-commitment/0.2-candidate and its corrected composite-key roles.
The frozen builders and allocation artifacts remain unchanged. The compiled model
passed 68 model checks, including the declared control family and state-domain
negatives; 17 construction checks separately cover actual CONTENT/VAL/key roles.

taskBootstrap appends model-owned deadline slots after the original input IDs and
sequences. Adoption does not affect their allocation. The original source compiler
continues to own its private branded authority. Its optional internal initial-state
decoder admits the successor state schemas without widening original input kinds.
RunIdentity commits the complete actual S0, not an empty or predecessor-state alias.

taskExecution admits only private M1 children and compiled clocks. It uses the
registered 343 subject projection, resolves declared targets without reading status,
and applies separately authorized replacements in root373. No output occurrence,
learned baseline, truth handle, belief lookup or motive is introduced. Terminal
states preserve the existing observation reference and exact instant.

adaptationRuntime composes the preserved group with prospective clocks/measurement
under the frozen stage grammar. Memory and prediction now have internal preflight
entry points which preserve their own source checks and actual subject-read records.
All group evaluations use B0, and composition rechecks each owned patch. The public
task factory has no injection or handler surface. Restore requires exact whole-save
equality after original S0/input replay before reconstructing private associations.
## Executed evidence so far

Twenty direct task runtime checks passed before the expanded control matrix: pure
clocks for three specimens; two simultaneous satisfactions; absent adoption;
recurrence at the old deadline; suppression; exact interval endpoints and adjacent
points; forged source exclusion before reads; all three subject projections before
prior reads; malformed stage/lifecycle and final-trace rollback; exact continuation.
The eight existing prediction-stage controls also passed after composition changes.

The 64 task permission/memory/prediction control combinations have subsequently
passed during the broader regression run. Their prospective result depends on
permitted M1 evidence, independently of memory/prediction enablement. Both deadlines
still execute, and the runtime occurrence count is unchanged by adoption or task
state. The final broad-run receipt and post-review corrections will be recorded
separately; this paragraph is not a claim that the entire suite has finished.
## Self-review corrections and remaining work

Complete target resolution must precede the collision phase, not merely precede
prior reads. Seal prospective preflight explicitly and test duplicate-key component
associations against the actual target mechanism. Also enforce source observation
time equal to the admitted instant directly, despite the fixed public producer
already generating matching times. These are implementation corrections under the
accepted contract, not new semantics or allocation.

Finish bootstrap/persistence adversaries, substitutions, historical live-list
comparison and current-source preservation/audit receipts. Old proof packets whose
source fingerprints include changed shared runtime files remain historical evidence;
do not label them current merely because the frozen model bytes are preserved.

Workspace, appraisal, concern, motive, procedural plan, options and arbitration
remain separate drafts. This lifecycle cannot stand in for the North Star's intact
cognitive cycle or the retained dice/identity proof. ORD-001 and PERSIST-I keep their
previous dispositions. No user decision is required for the remaining work.
